description: Fetch the full self-storage pricing snapshot for a document id returned by 'search' — a published suburb page ('suburb:nsw:chatswood'), a facility suburb ('place:nsw:bondi-junction', answered as a 10 km radius snapshot around the centroid of the facilities recorded there — result_scope='nearby' when those facilities carry no current prices), a capital-city scope ('city:nsw:sydney', answered as the city-radius snapshot plus the city's Storage Box Index figure), or 'index:national' (the national Storage Box Index figure and the city-scope ids). metadata carries suburb, state, the scope's facility_count, unit_count, medians and observed_at, a dated citation_text, and typed_tool_args: pass these verbatim to any tool in metadata.typed_tool_args_for (a suburb or city document lists cheapest_storage / compare_prices / storage_near among others; a locality document lists price_distribution only) to continue on the same place and scope. typed_tool_args is null when the document is not a place. result_scope says what kind of document this is; the same string is still sent as `coverage`, deprecated: read result_scope. A row with no verified link has booking_handoff_url null and booking_handoff_reason: 'no operator URL on file' or 'operator URL host is not on the verified booking allow-list'. Link users with booking_handoff_url (tracked, live booking page); url is the StoragePrices page.

id.description: Document id from a search result.

name: fetch
